proposed_rules.trigger: On a download/template page, a full-width template preview image ([2x1]/[3x1]/[3x2], sometimes [bg:image]) is immediately followed by an 'Install Free Template App' button, sometimes with a trailing empty spacer node.
proposed_rules.decision: Model the preview image and the install CTA as ONE composite block (image cell + CTA cell); treat any immediately-following empty spacer node as block-internal whitespace, not a separate section.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternatives: (a) split into a generic image block and a separate CTA link, obscuring that the image and button perform one paired action; (b) treat the trailing empty spacer (rc1c2c4, 1280x100, no text) as its own section, rejected because empty fixed-height spacer nodes carry no content and are layout artifacts, not sections.

provenance.evidence: C80 rc1c2c3 [3x2][bg:image] preview + rc1c2c3c3 'Install Free Template App'; rc1c2c4 empty 1280x100 spacer

proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width '[2x1] Get Started with Knack's ___' banner naming the specific template/app, positioned directly before the footer on template/download pages.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as a reusable CTA banner block parametrized by template name, not page-unique free text.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical structural position, size class, and wording pattern recur across all sampled download-template pages, indicating a shared component rather than one-off copy.

provenance.evidence: C80 rc1c2c6 [2x1] 1280x537 'Get Started with Knack's Class...'

notes: Standard download-template layout; an empty 100px spacer node (rc1c2c4) between the preview/install zone and the feature grid is treated as layout whitespace, not a section.
